title: Conference announcements seed document
description: Slug-keyed announcements imported into Supabase via public.import_announcements(). The slug is the natural key used to match rows across imports. Publishing a row (is_published: true) is what sends its push notification, once push is configured.

category.description: Must match the announcements_category_valid check constraint and AnnouncementCategory in the app. 'emergency' reaches every device regardless of its preferences.
